name: Files Studio
description: A unified file workspace for local folders, S3-compatible storage, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Huawei OBS, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS, and other OpenDAL services.
releaseNotes: 修复下载保存链路：沙箱工作台 iframe 内的程序化 <a download> 会被浏览器静默丢弃，此前在无宿主文件传输桥的环境（web/docker 或旧版 DBX 宿主）下载会「提示成功但本机没有文件」。现改为经宿主 host.saveFile 单次落盘桥（Host API 1.1）：桌面端弹原生保存对话框，取消不再假报成功，超过宿主 512 MiB 上限时明确报错；新增七语提示文案。Fixed the download save path: sandboxed workbench iframes silently drop programmatic <a download> clicks, so on hosts without the fileTransfer bridge (web/docker or older DBX hosts) downloads reported success without writing a file. Downloads now persist through the host host.saveFile bridge (Host API 1.1) with a native save dialog on desktop; cancelling no longer reports success, and payloads above the 512 MiB host cap fail with a clear error.

zh-CN.name: Files Studio
zh-CN.description: 统一管理本地文件夹、S3 兼容存储、Azure Blob、Google Cloud Storage、华为 OBS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS 等 OpenDAL 服务的文件工作台：传输任务、归档与受控运维集中在一个界面。
